    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

        r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in cells), max(i for i, j in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in cells), max(j for i, j in cells)
        shapes.append([[grid[i][j] for j in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for i in range(r0, r1 + 1)])

    width = sum(len(row[0]) for row in shapes)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    x = 0
    for shape in shapes:
        for i, row in enumerate(shape):
            out[i][x:x + len(row)] = row

    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objects = []
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v}:
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        shape = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        objects.append((r0,c0,r1,c1,shape))
    # Arrange the extracted motifs along their dominant spatial axis.
    rows = [o[0] for o in objects]
    cols = [o[1] for o in objects]
    horizontal = (max(cols)-min(cols)) >= (max(rows)-min(rows))
    objects.sort(key=lambda o: o[1] if horizontal else o[0])
    if horizontal:
        out = [[0] * (3*len(objects)) for _ in range(3)]
        for k, obj in enumerate(objects):
            shape=obj[4]
            for r in range(3):
                for c in range(3): out[r][3*k+c]=shape[r][c]
    else:
        out = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3*len(objects))]
        for k,obj in enumerate(objects):
            shape=obj[4]
            for r in range(3):
                for c in range(3): out[3*k+r][c]=shape[r][c]
    return out
